title: Cubetown: Echoes of the Maker
current_floor: V19R1 Maker's Journey verified installed Cubetown release inside the retained V25R3 PhantomPlay set; preserve its recovered V13-V18 systems plus the V19 hero, villager, echo, world, HUD, and safety upgrades
next_target: Post-promotion visual/input review and V20 polish; V19R1 is the no-regression floor
core_fantasy: A handcrafted storybook adventure where the Maker remembers creatures and world objects as living echoes, then combines them to fight, traverse, solve, and build a home in an impossible seasonal valley.
design_pillars: The Maker is a profession-readable adventure hero with a crimson mantle, teal field gear, a cyan echo rod, and complete locomotion/combat animation states — never a default pawn or permanently idling mesh.
Creature and object echoes are visible companions and physical tools, not passive inventory text.
Heartstone village, shrines, friendships, the Guardian, and sky-island landmarks create an authored adventure spine inside a freely explored world.
Combat, traversal, Memorycraft, Weave, Build Mode, puzzles, and town life combine rather than live in disconnected modes.
Every opening frame must show a readable path, crimson canopy, turquoise water or magic, warm architecture, friends or creatures, and a destination across foreground, midground, and background.

visual_identity.hero: The Maker — compact athletic adventurer, asymmetric crimson hooded mantle, deep-teal layered tunic, cream trousers, rugged boots, brass and leather maker kit, rune gauntlet, cyan crystal echo rod, lavender charm.
visual_identity.world: Warm storybook PBR with signature crimson canopy, teal ecology, cream and lavender stone, turquoise water and magic, warm timber, brass craft details, and composed diorama depth.
visual_identity.hud: Minimal near-black glass with cyan and crimson accents: life/stamina lower left, three Maker tools lower center, objective and distance upper right. No generic sci-fi shell and no purple-blue gradient UI.

forbidden_crossovers: Do not copy or imitate Nintendo, Zelda, Minecraft, Fortnite, Genshin, Pixar, or any other existing franchise.
Do not import Phantom Ages lane-battle controls or age progression.
Do not import Phantom Legends RTS selection or settlement economy.
Do not resurrect voxel block placement as the primary loop; architecture uses Build Mode and world manipulation uses Memorycraft.
Do not replace the existing multi-engine Cubetown web source; keep it as compatibility reference.
release_policy: V19R1 was transactionally promoted after the owner's exact literal PROMOTE authorization, with the previous V25R3 Cubetown preserved as a rollback checkpoint. Future revisions must package to a new isolated candidate and require a new exact PROMOTE authorization.
